title: 从个人 Agent 到团队 Loop：LoopForge 如何让团队工作流在云端持续运行
title_en: From personal agents to a team loop: how LoopForge keeps team workflows running in the cloud
summary: 把个人经验沉淀为团队角色和可复用 SOP，让共享上下文、过程留痕、持续改进与云端运行形成完整交付闭环。
summary_en: Turn individual expertise into team roles and reusable SOPs, with shared context, observable runs, continuous improvement and cloud execution.
author: LoopForge 团队

title: 从 0 到 1：部署平台，跑通第一条团队 SOP
title_en: From zero to one: deploy LoopForge and run your first team SOP
summary: 从安装、账号和凭证，到创建项目、配置四个角色、编排失败打回路径，再用一条真实需求完成首次运行与人工验收。
summary_en: Install, accounts and credentials, then a project, four roles and a send-back path on failure, finished with a first real run and human sign-off.
author: LoopForge 团队

title: 用 LoopForge 迭代 LoopForge：手把手搭一套 24 小时运转的 AI 研发工作台
title_en: Building LoopForge with LoopForge: a 24-hour AI engineering workbench, step by step
summary: AI 写代码很快，但盯流程、审 PR、解冲突依然耗人。本文以 LoopForge 维护自身仓库的线上环境为样板，分 10 步配齐沙箱、交付 SOP 与 5 个后台定时任务，附全套可照抄的 Prompt。
summary_en: AI writes code fast, but watching pipelines, reviewing PRs and resolving conflicts still wears people out. Using LoopForge's own repo as the example, ten steps set up sandboxes, a delivery SOP and five scheduled jobs, with every prompt included.
author: LoopForge 团队

title: 当 Coding Agent 走进研发团队：我们打造并开源了自进化研发平台 LoopForge
title_en: When coding agents join the engineering team: how we built and open-sourced the self-evolving LoopForge platform
summary: 从本地 Coding Agent 出发，复盘 LoopForge 如何依次解决云端运行、团队共享、工程级 SOP、无人值守自动化与递归自改进。
summary_en: A five-stage journey from local coding agents to shared cloud workspaces, engineering SOPs, unattended automation and recursive self-improvement.
author: LoopForge 团队
